name: proxy_ir851_six
notes: IR-851 subset of proxy_starter.json, less q15 (its quote sits on page 1 in a fresh Docling extraction and page 2 in LlamaParse and the starter label, so it cannot be scored on both): questions whose every expected passage is in one of six papers, one per category (ADR-056 amendment of 2026-11-03). Proxy tier, ADR-023: never a finding about CIT-U research. ADR-023 tier 1: an engineering gate. A number from this set decides whether a retrieval switch earns its place and is NEVER cited as a finding about CIT-U research. Question kinds follow docs/evaluation/README.md: paraphrased mechanism (the default), exact term or number, near-duplicate discrimination, and cross-paper; IR-463 adds general-knowledge, off-corpus-research, ambiguous, follow-up-after-direct and follow-up-after-grounded, which carry evidence_required and expected_outcome. Every quote is copied from the chunk text `manage.py inspect_chunks` prints, not from the PDF, because Docling respaces parentheses and maths.
